steps.title: Run the Linux ARM64 package
steps.instruction: Unpack the Linux ARM64 tarball for BanjoRecompiled. Start BanjoRecompiled from the extracted folder. The current ARM64 build needs glibc 2.35 or newer, SDL2, GTK 3, libatomic and a Vulkan-capable driver.

steps.title: Install the Linux x64 Flatpak
steps.instruction: Extract the Flatpak x64 ZIP to get io.github.banjorecomp.banjorecomp.flatpak. Install the file with Flatpak, then start io.github.banjorecomp.banjorecomp from the app menu or with flatpak run io.github.banjorecomp.banjorecomp.

steps.title: Select your original
steps.instruction: In the upstream game picker choose your own USA 1.0 Banjo-Kazooie cartridge dump. The game validates the matching original before play.

warnings: These packages use upstream or player-managed setup, replacement and data backups. Portcove has no native execution or populated-save result for these sibling packages.

references.title: Keep the external profile
references.instruction: Preserve ~/.config/BanjoRecompiled on Linux, or your actual custom profile. For Flatpak also keep ~/.var/app/io.github.banjorecomp.banjorecomp. Back up the original, saves, mods and settings before replacing an upstream copy.
